claims.text: Different kinds of offensive content explored include hate speech, cyberbullying, aggression, toxic comments, and offensive language.
Research has focused on specific types of offensive content such as aggression identification and bullying detection.
The study proposes a hierarchical annotation model to categorize offensive content more effectively.
